# Content or asset record — template

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Record ID | `<RECORD_ID>` |
| Type | content / image / illustration / component / data visualization |
| Intended user outcome | `<USER_RESULT>` |
| Lifecycle state | intake / plan / draft / validate / review / release / observe / quarantine |
| Source category | first-party / licensed / original / public-reference / unknown |
| Rights status | pending / verified / not-applicable |
| Privacy review | passed / blocked / not-applicable |
| Owner role | `<RESPONSIBLE_ROLE>` |

## Validation

- [ ] The source and rights boundary is explicit.
- [ ] The item contains no third-party identity, credentials, private paths, production data, or unapproved reference material.
- [ ] The item matches the user outcome and design system.
- [ ] Accessibility details are present when applicable (alt text, caption, transcript, keyboard operation).
- [ ] The next lifecycle transition has a named evidence requirement.

## Release evidence

Record a candidate identifier, validation command/output, reviewer role, and recovery action here. Do not include access details or secrets.
